title: Accessibility follow-up: scoped review and publication evidence
status: 21 exact main/CI/READY production sources and live browser suites verified; real native browser zoom completed for sampled states. Full real NVDA task flows, Selimoglu hosting update and fresh authenticated Search Console checks remain blocked.

interpretation.conformance: Not determined. Passing sampled checks and successful CI/deployment do not establish that all WCAG criteria or complete assistive-technology flows pass.
interpretation.browserMethod: Isolated Chrome scripted keyboard events, source/DOM/style review, screenshots, equivalent viewport reflow and preference emulation. Canonical live suites kept production CSP unmodified.
interpretation.countMeaning: Test counts are test cases, not WCAG criteria, unique barriers, complete user journeys or independent users. Different groups test different scopes. Repeated widths and fixture states are counted separately where stated.
interpretation.privacy: Only public canonical URLs, repository and deployment identities, aggregate results, synthetic/public screenshots and sanitized observations are included.

publicationSnapshot.method: Per-record remote main SHA, canonical READY Vercel alias, exact-SHA successful push CI and live production browser suite. Observation times differ across records.

localUnitTests.semantics: Existing project unit suites, including regressions; not all are accessibility tests.

localProductionBuilds.staticDecisionPage: Decision Recheck is static; its eight demo browser tests are counted below.

canonicalLiveBrowserTests.meaning: Latest passing test cases per project; repeat runs and native zoom states are not added to this total.

additionalLocalTests.scope: Synthetic/loopback local scanner and isolated actual extension; separate from canonical live browser totals.

groupC.method: Computed sRGB foreground and effective opacity compared with actual rendered backgrounds. Text glyphs were made transparent only in the test context and computed backgrounds frozen; gradients and pseudo elements remained rendered. Direct scrolled element screenshots replaced full-page geometry/scrollbar mismatches. Only aligned foreground ink pixels with at least 50% antialias coverage were sampled. Product CSS and production CSP were not weakened.
groupC.thresholds: Normal text 4.5:1; large text and meaningful graphical symbols 3:1. Redundant decorative or inactive elements are recorded separately, not counted as measured passes.

groupB.semantics: Color-contrast incomplete rows from seven projects at 1440/640/320 CSS pixels. The same DOM target at multiple widths counts multiple times. These are neither 133 unique issues nor 133 measured color pairs.
groupB.disposition: Each row has a reviewed basis; no remaining demonstrated violation in those sampled initial states. Decorative redundant icons and images were distinguished from meaningful numerals and controls; meaningful contrast defects were repaired.

handrailPublishedZip.semantics: SHA-256 of each uncompressed published ZIP member equals its reviewed local counterpart; this is byte identity, not just CRLF equivalence. It does not establish behavior in every browser or user website.

selimogluLocalReview.publication: NOT_UPLOADED: live EN/TR still reference site-v3.js; reviewed Git main source references site-v4.js. Hosting browser control is blocked.

twelveViewCrossReview.skipLink: Native hash activation leaves document.activeElement as BODY; the next Tab advances to the main Explore the projects CTA in both languages. Explicit focus on main was not claimed.

selimogluLocalReview.preserve: Existing site-v3.js for cached HTML; .htaccess, verification files, nope/ and unrelated assets.

assistiveTechnologySnapshot.method: Actual native Chrome keyboard input with NVDA No Speech and the real Speech Viewer; no audible voice assessment.
assistiveTechnologySnapshot.scope: Selimoglu title, skip link and Elements List observed. App forms, widgets, dynamic announcements and modal task completion were not completed.
assistiveTechnologySnapshot.finding: Brand link text was concatenated; a literal separating space was repaired in both source languages. This was a text-reading observation, not an audible pronunciation test.
assistiveTechnologySnapshot.repairStatus: Local generated-source regression passed; hosting publication and repeat NVDA observation pending.
assistiveTechnologySnapshot.completion: Partial; native input became unavailable. No complete app AT pass, JAWS, VoiceOver or braille verification is claimed.
assistiveTechnologySnapshot.normalShutdown: Only the exact task portable NVDA process exited normally via official --quit; no installation/autostart. Earlier Escape handoff superseded.
blockers: Computer Use helper already has an active request

publicHttpSeoSnapshot.qualification: Unauthenticated public HTTP evidence only; no authenticated property, sitemap processing, URL Inspection, indexing request or indexing outcome is established.

nativeBrowserZoomReview.method: Native Chromium chrome.tabs.setZoom(2/4), automatic per-tab mode, read back getZoom; fresh temporary persistent profile with task-local extension. viewport:null. No setViewportSize, device metrics override, pageScale, CSS zoom/transform, or user Chrome/profile access.
nativeBrowserZoomReview.viewportContract: 1298x1120 outer Windows window gives exactly1280x1024 baseline content; native zoom produces640x512 and320x256. The extra18x96 are browser window frame/chrome, not page viewport emulation.
nativeBrowserZoomReview.qualification: Scripted native browser zoom plus visual/geometry review. Not human browser-menu operation, NVDA compatibility or full-page WCAG conformance. Long findings can exceed viewport height while visibly intersecting it.
